C-DEALER-CARD-FIDELITY.Summary: Apply the visual fidelity audit explicitly approved by the user: game-proportioned Used cards and open Hagerty columns with accurate companion data.

Goals.Goal: Match reference proportions, photography, type hierarchy, PP/drive row, small credit prefix, mileage icon and warning status.
Replace full Hagerty borders with corner marks; normalize logo/model/year/image/price positions against the reference and preserve horizontal desktop scrolling.

Constraints.Constraint: Retain exact real metadata, unknown mileage/ownership, local assets, persistent wishlist, phone pull-to-refresh and shared navigation. Never invent ownership icons or mileage.
Phone portrait remains a responsive adaptation; game font and source imagery are not guaranteed identical assets.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No protocol, data source, music, gallery, account or purchasing changes; no commit/push.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Visible Used geometry approaches 2.86 width/height with a 3:2 photographic panel; fallback silhouettes remain fully visible.
Hagerty uses one desktop row, corner marks, consistent visual anchors and smaller credit prefix. RU/EN and enlarged text remain usable.
Real Mac and visible iPhone inspection with permanent responsive/action tests.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: Targeted Flutter tests/analyzer and GRACE lint.
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Reference comparison and live Mac/visible iPhone screenshots.
